title: Nonperforming Loan Disposals Without Resolution
authors: Ben Charoenwong; Meng Miao; Tianyue Ruan
near_miss_reason: Time-varying controls in every column. Table 10 regresses bank-year zombie-lending measures on Post_NPL_Offloading (1 from the bank's first NPL sale onward, a bank-specific year) with bank and year FE, but all six columns include lagged time-varying controls (GDP_province_g_lagged electricity_g_lagged deposit_g_lagged). Dropping the controls from columns 1, 2, 5, 6 would give eligible static TWFE specifications (Zombie_measure ~ Post_NPL_Offloading | code + year, cluster code). Columns 3-4 are unbinned event-time indicators (F2, F1, 0, L1, L2 of First_NPL_Offloading) with the same controls.
eligible_reason: Design qualifies: binary absorbing treatment Post_NPL_Offloading switching on at bank-specific first-NPL-sale years within a 2014-2019 bank-year panel (xtset code year, strongly balanced; N = 314 bank-years in cols 1-2, 5-6, i.e. roughly 52 banks), bank FE + year FE, cluster by bank. Not eligible as reported because every column adds time-varying lagged controls. Caveats: the number of distinct first-sale years cannot be verified without the data (plausibly 2015-2019); whether some banks never sell NPLs in-sample (never-treated) is also unverified. Tables 5-6 and 9 use pvcra_cut_1 (allowance/NPL < 150%, a violation indicator that can switch on and off) as regressor, not an absorbing adoption; Tables 3 and 8 are transaction-level cross-sections.
design_notes: Code/Table_10.do: use Data/NPL_banklevel; xtset code year; global controls GDP_province_g_lagged electricity_g_lagged deposit_g_lagged; reghdfe Zombie_measure1 ${controls} Post_NPL_Offloading, absorb(code year) vce(cluster code) [col 1]; Zombie_measure2 [col 2]; cols 3-4 replace Post with f2/f1/0/l1/l2 of First_NPL_Offloading (N=138); cols 5-6 Non_zombie_measure1/2. Log (on actual data) reports Post coefficients 1.938 (t 3.32), 2.019 (t 3.75), -1.567 (t -0.35), -1.987 (t -0.21), N=314.
estimators_reported: TWFE static with controls (reghdfe, Table 10 cols 1-2, 5-6)
